value.signature: fn content_pre_digest (id : & ActId , pair : & ContentPair) -> Result < ContentPreDigest , ProfileError >

review.body: { if ! valid_id (id) { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } nonce_format (id , & pair . nonce) ? ; payload_length (& pair . payload) ? ; Ok (ContentPreDigest { act : id . clone () , bytes : hash (PROPOSAL_RECIPE , "PN-content-pre-v2" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , SecretValue :: Bytes (pair . nonce . clone ()) , SecretValue :: Bytes (pair . payload . clone ()) ,] ,) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
